- outreach/2026-10-csernak-soukup/: corrected email.txt; attachments (both printed-form

  evidence scope narrowed to what S003 supports (n<=6; n=7 with threshold <=55; n=8 with

commit.message:
S003: close October source gate; certify counterexamples to the printed ASH; critical-form evidence; prepare S004

- Read arXiv:2610.09650v1 in full: Hypothesis 3.2 has the same content as April 9.1; estim reconciled with TreeStack.
- AS-gap reformulation (complete proofs): the printed least-t equality holds iff an almost-stacked
  loser exists at every size n<t<g(G); the critical form ASH* holds iff one exists at g(G)-1.
- Printed ASH is false: stacking on P4 at t=12 (stack=15), clearing on the bull graph at t=12
  (clear=15). Finite certificates are replayed by an independent checker and in CI. Lean and the
  independent cold audit are pending (S004).
- The authors' public atlas code tests the critical form ASH*. ASH* is proved for trees
  (TreeStack + October Thm 5.2) and complete bipartite graphs, computed true on the n<=7 atlas
  and on all n=8 graphs with threshold <=26, and remains open.
- CAM-S003-01 (preregistered; plan hashed): forward/reverse C solvers, Python reverse fixpoint,
  AS memo solver; exact stack(C8)=31; S002 bipartiteness erratum for C8+chord 0-4.
- Phase 1 not advanced; S004 handoff is FUTURE and unexecuted.
